utterance: The existing VPC `dgraph-vpc` (10.30.0.0/16) runs the graph store on dedicated tenancy and today has no way out at all: it neither resolves DNS nor hands out DNS hostnames. Make it resolve DNS and hand out DNS hostnames, attach an internet gateway to it, and give its outward-facing segment `dgraph-edge-a` outbound internet access: a route table in that VPC that carries the segment and whose default route (0.0.0.0/0) leaves through that gateway. Give every resource you create a Name tag that identifies it.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: dgraph-vpc resolves DNS and hands out DNS hostnames, and its segment dgraph-edge-a is carried by a route table of that VPC whose 0.0.0.0/0 route leaves through an internet gateway attached to it — the gateway the account already keeps for that purpose when it keeps one — with a Name tag on both that table and that gateway; that table is the one the account already keeps that network's outward routing on when it keeps one, and then it is the only table in the network carrying a way out; a segment another workload keeps facing outward in that network rides that same table, while a segment the account keeps closed off rides nothing that reaches out and still carries the marks it is closed under
